policy: wisdomdesign CI never executes xcodebuild / gradle and never claims a native pass. Each native/UI layer required by change-scope routing must be registered here with its owner, command, real status and an evidence reference owned by the platform repo. L2 validates the registration and the evidence reference; it does not re-run the platform command.

ios-native-compile.command: CFFIXED_USER_HOME=$PWD/iOS/.build/home xcodebuild build -project iOS/AIStarter/AIStarter.xcodeproj -scheme AIStarter -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath iOS/.build/dd-ai-starter-rel CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
ios-native-compile.statusNote: Consumer Release build of AIStarter against the real WisdomUI public module; re-run exit 0 on 2026-11-22.
